Demo results and visualization gallery

Source: vignettes/demo-results.Rmd
demo-results.Rmd

Scope

This gallery summarizes GnRHcell outputs stored in the five bundled Seurat demo objects. The objects cover hPSC-derived GnRH differentiation, the developing human nose, the human median eminence, and integrated mouse and human hypothalamic references.

The objects are compact, preprocessed, and intentionally retain GnRH-relevant cells. Consequently, detection fractions in this gallery are not estimates of GnRH-cell prevalence in the source tissues or complete atlases.

Detection across demo objects

Red points are cells classified as gnrh_status == "pos"; grey points are all other cells. GnRH-detected cells occupy localized or connected transcriptional neighborhoods in each demo embedding. The figure is descriptive of the bundled objects and does not establish sensitivity or specificity against an external reference annotation.

The machine-readable table is available as demo-results.csv. Values are derived directly from gnrh_status and gnrh_stage in the bundled objects.

Developmental-stage composition

The hPSC-derived and fetal-nose objects retain substantial identity and migrating populations. The hypothalamic references are dominated by cells classified as mature, consistent with their tissue context. These assignments represent model-based hypotheses for downstream marker analysis and experimental validation.

Reproduce the summary 

library(GnRHcell)

ids <- c(
  "hpsc", "hudeca_nose", "human_me",
  "mouse_hypomap", "human_hypomap"
)

objects <- setNames(
  lapply(ids, function(id) {
    readRDS(system.file("extdata", paste0(id, ".rds"), package = "GnRHcell"))
  }),
  ids
)

summarise_demo <- function(object) {
  md <- object[[]]
  positive <- md$gnrh_status == "pos"

  data.frame(
    cells = nrow(md),
    gnrh_detected = sum(positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    identity = sum(md$gnrh_stage == "identity", na.rm = TRUE),
    migrating = sum(md$gnrh_stage == "migrating", na.rm = TRUE),
    mature = sum(md$gnrh_stage == "mature", na.rm = TRUE),
    secreting = sum(md$gnrh_stage == "secreting", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

do.call(rbind, lapply(objects, summarise_demo))

The static assets used by the README and this page can be regenerated from the package root with:

Rscript data-raw/build-demo-gallery.R

Interpretation checklist

  • Treat the demo objects as examples of package behavior, not population-level sampling frames.
  • Use an independent truth annotation for external ROC analysis.
  • Confirm stage assignments with marker expression, donor consistency, and biological context.
  • Cite both GnRHcell and the primary study associated with each source dataset.
